title: What Breaks Local Watermarks? A Robustness Benchmark for Local Invisible Image Watermarking
abstract: arXiv:2609.16832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Local image watermarking embeds an invisible signal into selected image regions rather than spreading it across the entire image, enabling payload recovery from specific objects or regions without perceptibly altering the image. Existing studies evaluate the robustness of payload recovery and localization under image transformations, but they often focus on their own proposed method, resulting in narrow evaluations with inconsistent choices of transformations, datasets, and metrics. These inconsistencies across studies limit direct comparisons across methods and muddle the overall picture of local watermark robustness. To address this gap, we present the first systematic robustness benchmark for local watermarks across 55 image transformations, including (i) signal distortions, (ii) changes in image coordinate alignment, (iii) indirect local edits, and (iv) direct watermark edits. The benchmark evaluates MaskWM, WAM, OmniGuard, TrustMa

translated_title: 什么会破坏局部水印？局部不可见图像水印的鲁棒性基准测试
translated_abstract: 局部图像水印将不可见信号嵌入到选定的图像区域中，而不是将其扩散到整个图像，从而能够在不明显改变图像的情况下从特定对象或区域恢复载荷信息。现有研究在图像变换下评估载荷恢复与定位的鲁棒性，但它们往往只关注各自提出的方法，导致评估范围狭窄，且在变换、数据集和指标的选择上不一致。这些跨研究的不一致性限制了方法之间的直接比较，也模糊了局部水印鲁棒性的整体图景。为填补这一空白，我们提出了首个针对局部水印的系统性鲁棒性基准，涵盖55种图像变换，包括：（i）信号失真、（ii）图像坐标对齐变化、（iii）间接局部编辑，以及（iv）直接水印编辑。该基准对MaskWM、WAM、OmniGuard、TrustMa等（摘要原文在此处被截断）进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对局部不可见图像水印的系统性鲁棒性基准，通过55种涵盖信号失真、坐标对齐变化、间接局部编辑和直接水印编辑的图像变换，对现有方法进行了统一评估，解决了以往评估不一致、难以直接比较的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic robustness benchmark for local invisible image watermarks, evaluating existing methods across 55 image transformations covering signal distortions, coordinate misalignment, indirect local edits, and direct watermark edits, thereby addressing the inconsistency and narrowness of prior evaluations.
